_note: Valency tags for verbs whose lexicon gloss misleads planners (tier3-b001 review S1, b002 R6). 'tr': transitive, the active needs an object and a patient subject takes the middle. 'intr': intransitive. The gloss, when given, replaces the lexicon gloss in slices. 'fear': a verb of fearing; what is feared is ablative (Ved. bhī- + abl., 'fear from'), never an object (t3b-004, t039, t042 reviews); the causatives 'scare' (troséyeti, torgʷéyeti) are ordinary transitives.
